title: Efficient Image Reconstruction Architecture for Neutral Atom Quantum Computing
summary: In recent years, neutral atom quantum computers (NAQCs) have attracted a lot of attention, primarily due to their long coherence times and good scalability. One of their main drawbacks is their comparatively time-consuming control overhead, with one of the main contributing procedures being the detection of individual atoms and measurement of their states, each occurring at least once per compute cycle and requiring fluorescence imaging and subsequent image analysis. To reduce the required time budget, we propose a highly-parallel atom-detection accelerator for tweezer-based NAQCs. Building…
